concepts.name: Organic versus paid results
concepts.summary: Distinguish unpaid organic listings from ads on a search results page and recognise that SEO targets the organic ones.

concepts.name: Crawl, index, rank pipeline
concepts.summary: Explain that a search engine discovers pages by crawling, stores them in an index, and then ranks indexed pages for each query.

concepts.name: Keywords and search queries
concepts.summary: Recognise that people type queries into search engines and that pages are matched to those words and their meaning.

concepts.name: Search intent types
concepts.summary: Explain the informational, navigational, commercial and transactional intents behind queries and why a page must match the intent.

concepts.name: Title tag and meta description
concepts.summary: Describe how the title tag and meta description appear in results and what role each plays in attracting clicks.

concepts.name: Headings and page content
concepts.summary: Understand how headings structure a page's content for readers and search engines.

concepts.name: Links as votes of trust
concepts.summary: Explain that links from other sites act as signals of a page's credibility and help crawlers discover pages.

misconceptions.text: SEO means tricking Google with hidden keywords to get to the top.
Once a page is published it is automatically in Google's results.
The meta description directly makes a page rank higher.

concepts.name: Basic keyword research workflow
concepts.summary: Use a keyword tool to find terms, compare search volume and difficulty, and shortlist keywords for a page.

concepts.name: Mapping keywords to intent
concepts.summary: Inspect the top results for a query to judge intent and choose the right page type for it.

concepts.name: Writing effective title tags
concepts.summary: Write unique titles with the primary keyword near the front, suitable length and a clear reason to click.

concepts.name: Writing meta descriptions
concepts.summary: Write unique, accurate descriptions that summarise the page and encourage clicks, knowing Google may rewrite them.

concepts.name: Heading hierarchy and URLs
concepts.summary: Apply a single descriptive H1, logical subheadings and short readable URLs to a page.

concepts.name: Internal linking with anchor text
concepts.summary: Add contextual links between related pages using descriptive anchor text so users and crawlers can navigate.

concepts.name: Robots.txt and XML sitemaps
concepts.summary: Explain what robots.txt and XML sitemaps do and set up simple versions for a small site.

concepts.name: Search Console basics
concepts.summary: Verify a site, submit a sitemap and read the performance report for queries, clicks, impressions and position.

misconceptions.text: Targeting the highest-volume keyword is always the best choice.
Robots.txt keeps a page out of Google's index reliably.
More keywords stuffed into the title and headings improves rankings.

concepts.name: Topic clusters and content gaps
concepts.summary: Analyse a keyword set to group queries into topics, spot gaps against competitors and plan pillar and supporting pages.

concepts.name: Indexing diagnostics
concepts.summary: Use Search Console to diagnose why pages are not indexed, such as noindex, crawled-not-indexed or blocked URLs.

concepts.name: Canonicalisation and duplicates
concepts.summary: Handle duplicate or parameterised URLs with canonical tags and redirects so signals consolidate on one URL.

concepts.name: Redirects and status codes
concepts.summary: Choose among 200, 301, 302, 404 and 410 responses and implement redirects during migrations or URL changes.

concepts.name: Core Web Vitals metrics
concepts.summary: Interpret LCP, INP and CLS using lab and field data and trace poor scores to causes like large images or layout shifts.

concepts.name: Structured data with schema
concepts.summary: Add JSON-LD markup for types like Article, Product or FAQ and validate it to qualify for rich results.

concepts.name: Backlink quality assessment
concepts.summary: Evaluate links by relevance, authority and editorial context rather than raw count.

concepts.name: Technical site audit
concepts.summary: Run a crawler and Search Console review to find and prioritise issues like broken links, thin pages and missing tags.

misconceptions.text: Schema markup is a direct ranking boost.
Duplicate content triggers a penalty that must be avoided at all costs.
A good Lighthouse score guarantees good Core Web Vitals for real users.

concepts.name: Crawl budget optimisation
concepts.summary: Analyse server logs and crawl stats to find wasted crawling on faceted, parameter or low-value URLs and fix it.

concepts.name: Rendering and JavaScript SEO
concepts.summary: Assess how JavaScript rendering affects indexing and choose between server-side, static and client-side approaches.

concepts.name: Site architecture and link equity
concepts.summary: Judge and redesign site structure, depth and internal linking to distribute authority to priority pages.

concepts.name: Link building strategy evaluation
concepts.summary: Evaluate link acquisition tactics for effectiveness and risk, distinguishing earned links from manipulative schemes.

concepts.name: Migration planning and risk
concepts.summary: Assess a domain or platform migration plan, with redirect mapping, pre and post benchmarks and rollback checks.

concepts.name: Content quality and E-E-A-T
concepts.summary: Evaluate content against quality guidelines for experience, expertise, authority and trust and decide what to improve or prune.

concepts.name: International and multilingual SEO
concepts.summary: Analyse hreflang, domain structure and localisation choices for sites serving multiple languages or regions.

concepts.name: SEO measurement and attribution
concepts.summary: Judge organic performance with rankings, traffic, conversions and Search Console data while accounting for seasonality and updates.

misconceptions.text: Google renders all JavaScript content instantly and perfectly, so rendering strategy is irrelevant.
Crawl budget is a concern for every website.
Deleting or disavowing links is routine maintenance for any site.

concepts.name: Algorithm update diagnosis
concepts.summary: Critically assess traffic changes around algorithm updates to separate causes from coincidence and decide on a response.

concepts.name: Enterprise SEO governance
concepts.summary: Evaluate processes, templates and team responsibilities that keep SEO quality across large sites and many contributors.

concepts.name: Programmatic SEO design
concepts.summary: Design templated page systems with unique value, safeguards against thin content and scalable internal linking.

concepts.name: SEO experimentation framework
concepts.summary: Create controlled tests using page groups and statistical modelling to measure the effect of SEO changes.

concepts.name: Search in AI-driven results
concepts.summary: Evaluate how generative answers, SERP features and zero-click results change visibility strategy and measurement.

concepts.name: Entity and topical authority strategy
concepts.summary: Build a strategy that establishes a brand and topics as recognised entities through content, markup and off-site signals.

concepts.name: SEO business case and prioritisation
concepts.summary: Create forecasts and prioritisation models that size opportunities and justify investment against other channels.

misconceptions.text: Every ranking drop after an update means the site was penalised and needs fixing.
Publishing thousands of templated pages reliably scales organic traffic.
SEO changes can be tested like A/B tests by splitting users between versions.
